sections.content_text: Section 2 Clause 3 - Precedence of Law Precedence of Law.-(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, the provisions of this Act shall prevail. (2) If any other law or any provision thereof is inconsistent with any provision of this Act, the said Act or the provision of that Act shall be deemed to be invalid to the extent of the inconsistency.
